build: ./autogen.sh && ./configure --disable-examples --with-pic && make; upstream tree built in place, no source patch
interface: ctypes over speex_preprocess_state_init / speex_preprocess_ctl / speex_preprocess_run / speex_preprocess_state_destroy
configuration: denoise on; AGC, VAD, dereverb, echo suppression, active echo suppression all off; echo state null; noise suppression left at the upstream default and queried with GET_NOISE_SUPPRESS rather than overridden
geometry: 160-sample frames at 16 kHz; final partial frame zero-padded and trimmed back to the input length; one state per sample
